'''Remote servos''' were [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] components used on vessels such as [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing's]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]]. Used in combination with [[hydraulic actuator]]s, an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] could conduct extensive repairs utilizing remote servos.<ref name="SWS" />
